answer: Proof-of-stake consensus functions as a digital jetty, breaking the gale of Sybil nodes by tying influence to capital commitment rather than ephemeral identities. To inflate network control, an adversary must overcome the tide of opportunity cost associated with locking assets, as acquiring sufficient stake becomes prohibitively expensive. The mechanism forces attackers to internalize the risk of asset depreciation, ensuring that fake-identity expansion remains economically irrational.
